name: Glipizide
description: A second-generation sulfonylurea that closes the beta-cell ATP-sensitive potassium channel to drive insulin secretion, approved for type 2 diabetes.

systems.note: Glucose-independent insulin secretion from the beta cell; the labelled indication.
Haemolytic anaemia is labelled, notably in G6PD deficiency.

monitors.why: Secretion is glucose-independent, so hypoglycaemia is the characteristic risk.
